image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, earthy surface. The amphibian displays characteristic glossy black skin with vivid, irregular yellow blotches and stripes covering its head, back, and limbs. Its body is robust and cylindrical, curving slightly to the left. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind small, dark eyes. Short, stout limbs with distinct digits are visible supporting the body.
